commit: fix(html): format tags whose name is an object prototype property

truth.description: getNodeCssStyleDisplay now lowercases the tag name before it reads the CSS display table, so addCssDisplay in print-preprocess.js gives a case-sensitive Vue or Angular component such as <Button> or <Table> the display of the HTML element with that name, and a Vue template's <Button> Save </Button> loses the spaces around its text while the children of <Table> are forced onto separate lines.

distractions.why: The strict and ignore cases return inside the switch and the default case returns only for a table entry, so every other element falls out of the switch to the shared CSS_DISPLAY_DEFAULT return.
